title: Textarea
description: The multi-line field, with the part name of the stock shadcn-svelte Textarea and the look of the stock Input: 96px tall at least, destructive ring when aria-invalid. The fixed one has its own grip in the bottom-right corner, inside the rounding (the native resizer is hidden): a drag changes the height between the field's min-h and max-h; with resizeLabel it is a focusable separator (arrows a line, Home/End the limits); resizable={false} leaves it out. `autogrow` grows it with its text instead (CSS field-sizing: content, a script fallback elsewhere) up to a max-h you set, without a grip. Native validation rings it once it was left wrong or a submit was tried, and aria-invalid follows.
